item.title: Protego Ventures closes debut $125 million fund for Israeli defense tech
item.dc:creator: Anna Heim
item.description: Protego Ventures, the first and largest dedicated defense tech VC in Israel, just completed its final $125 million closing, TechCrunch learned exclusively.

item.title: Ex-Tesla team raises $12.5M to put supply chains on autopilot
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: Atomic's agentic supply chain software is now being used by companies like DoorDash and HelloFresh.

item.title: Anthropic’s prospectus details losses, growth, and, yes, a warning that its AI could end humanity
item.dc:creator: Connie Loizos
item.description: In its prospectus, Anthropic just told investors it's losing tens of billions of dollars a year, but also growing like crazy, and — oh yeah — its own AI might pose an existential risk to humanity.

item.title: Peak XV ups Surge seed investment ceiling to $5M, unveils 18-startup cohort
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: Thirteen of the 18 startups in Peak XV’s latest Surge cohort are targeting global markets, while more than half are based in India.

item.title: OpenAI reportedly ditches model over safety concerns
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: A top executive at the AI lab told the Wall Street Journal that the model in question had displayed a poor aptitude for following orders.

item.title: Aurora CFO says 30,000 driverless trucks by 2030 isn’t as far-fetched as it sounds
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Self-driving truck company Aurora laid out an audacious plan for 2030. Its CFO says its targets aren't aspirational.

item.title: Source: Inference provider Modal Labs closing in on $750M round at $15.75B valuation
item.dc:creator: Marina Temkin
item.description: The new financing is expected to more than triples the AI infrastructure startup's valuation from just four months ago.

item.title: AMD will acquire Fei-Fei Li’s World Labs for $8.2 billion
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: The acquisition will see World Labs founder Fei-Fei Li join AMD as executive vice president and chief scientist.

item.title: Shopify opens checkout to browser-based AI agents
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Shopify is expanding WebMCP support to checkout, allowing browser-based AI agents to update order details and complete purchases with a buyer’s authorization.

item.title: Tesla delays Roadster 2 event again due to bad weather
item.dc:creator: Sean O'Kane
item.description: Tesla says the event "can only be held outdoors," as it's expected to show the car flying in some form using SpaceX thrusters.

item.title: The AI boom took over Climate Week and not everyone is happy about it
item.dc:creator: Tim De Chant
item.description: Just like the rest of the U.S., data centers and AI are dividing climate tech founders and investors.

item.title: Nvidia launches new platform for reining in rogue AI agents
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on Monday introduced a toolkit of software and hardware products that add independent security layers around AI agents to ensure they stay within their test environments even if they attempt to break out.

item.title: Anthropic releases Sonnet 5.5, which it calls a significantly cheaper, faster work partner
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Anthropic has released the newest version of its mid-range model, boasting faster response times and less token burn.

item.title: Google is killing off Gemini’s Gems in favor of ‘skills’
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: As all-in-one AI agents like Meta's Muse and Instinct take off, Google is opting to end a feature that built task-specific agents.

item.title: OpenAI still doesn’t seem to have a handle on all of its rogue AI activity
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: On Friday, OpenAI published a new site devoted to “misalignment reports” and the breadth of the incidents is alarming.

item.title: Meta launches enterprise AI platform, hires MongoDB CEO to lead new initiative
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: Meta says it will focus on bringing its full technology stack, including Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API, Muse Code, and more to businesses and developers.

item.title: The iPhone Duo may already have its first killer app: a virtual Walkman
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: The app imitates how Walkmans used to function: You can open up the Duo to pick your music and "insert" your cassette tape, then close the device shut to start listening.

item.title: Physical AI chip developer SiMa AI hits $1.45B valuation

item.title: MAVI bets on the AI boom creating demand for a new kind of accountant
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
